description: WDPM, the Wetland DEM Ponding Model, maps how water fills landscape depressions. Its developers focus on the Canadian Prairies, where flat terrain and many pothole wetlands interrupt dendritic drainage. The JOSS paper and own README identify a DEM-based model and the public repository reports GPL-3.0, so the code is free. Spatial resolution follows the DEM and its depression geometry; temporal representation is the water-volume or event scenario, not an automatically observed time series. A drainage or flood modeller could use the resulting ponding map to represent storage and connectivity near roads, farms or settlements. A caveat is that DEM errors, culverts, frozen ground and groundwater exchange can change where water actually moves. The model is not a complete hydrodynamic flood forecast. Applications beyond similar prairie terrain need separate validation. No directly related catalogue record was found. The article and own repository were read without obtaining DEM data or running an event.
name: WDPM wetland depression ponding model
notes: G5 G5-0857. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
